statement: Grok Bot is the SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) computer-use agent run with Cursor, in beta since Aug 11 2026: Bots with a persistent cloud computer (browser, filesystem, terminal) in one Firecracker microVM per user, that sign into a user's tools and hand any password, CAPTCHA or payment step back to a human. Its own pages print no dollar price for the agent alone (it rides on Cursor plans from $20 a month and SuperGrok at $30 a month on a third party table), no latency and no agent benchmark. Of 54 measures, 3 have a number on both sides. Speed: a third party time to first token of 51.22 s for Grok 4.7 against our hosted round trip of 0.2118 s on one arithmetic prompt (bench/verdicts/site-ask.json at 2026-09-28T01:24:06.785Z), 241.8319169x, not the same prompts. GSM8K: xAI printed 90 percent 8-shot for Grok-1.5 (Mar 2024; no Grok 4.x page read prints GSM8K) and on the same 1319 test records the organism scored 1189 of 1319 = 90.14% (bench/verdicts/public-gsm8k.json at 2026-09-27T21:56:32.679Z), 1.01461039x on error, and their 90 lies inside our 95 percent interval (88.42 to 91.64), so the organism is not shown better than Grok-1.5. HumanEval: xAI printed 88.4 percent for Grok-2 (Aug 2024) on the Python set and the organism passed 123 of 161 = 76.40% on the JavaScript records both arms graded, 40 of them development records (bench/verdicts/public-humaneval.json, whole set at 2026-09-28T01:41:13.471Z), 0.4914736842x on error. Like with like, each against its control on the same records: GSM8K all records, organism 1189 of 1319 = 90.14% against the same model alone 1041 of 1319 = 78.92% and null 17 of 1319 = 1.29%; GSM8K held out, organism 1007 of 1116 = 90.23% against alone 875 of 1116 = 78.41%; HumanEval, organism 123 of 161 = 76.40% against alone 82 of 161 = 50.93% (on the 121 held-out records both graded, 84 against 51). The speed row and the accuracy rows run on different paths: the 0.2118 s answer is the exact route, which answered 14 of 1319 GSM8K records; through the model cell the organism took a mean 25818.61 ms per GSM8K task against 6843.06 ms for the model alone. On the 291 prompts over 41 kinds a person conceives (bench/verdicts/conceive.json at 2026-09-28T12:18:03.618Z), the organism with its model off answered 12.37 percent natively and refused the rest, passed 6.08 percent of the gradeable ones, and took a median 775500 ns per ask (87600 ns per native answer); with its knowledge tier off, as on dilation.dev, it answered 9.28 percent natively; no Grok page read prints a number on those prompts, so these rows carry no ratio. No verdict prints our price in dollars, so no "cheaper" ratio exists yet. No model was called and nothing was trained.
